mathematical_review.normalization: prod_eraseAt compares the off-pivot products via update_of_ne and then uses deletedProduct_mul with pivot value 1. Every actual deletionFiber image member consequently has b_i=1 and full product d. The argument is for arbitrary finite S and arbitrary natural d; it assumes neither a fixed product n nor a tau identity.
mathematical_review.compression_product: Fin.prod_univ_succAbove b i states product(b)=b_i*product_j b(i.succAbove j). Normalization replaces b_i by 1, so the compressed product is exactly d. hp.symm.trans hinfo.2 has the correct orientation and compressDeleted reduces to the displayed coordinate map.
mathematical_review.maps_to_exact_carrier: dvd_prod_of_mem shows each compressed coordinate divides the compressed product, hence d. Positivity hd gives d!=0 for Nat.mem_divisors; PiFinset membership and product=d are both explicitly proved. The codomain is the actual existing orderedFactorTuples k d, not an abstract tuple-count supplier.
mathematical_review.compression_injection: Both pivot values are 1. At an off-pivot j, hji:j!=i is passed to the actual Fin.exists_succAbove_eq signature, yielding r with i.succAbove r=j. congrFun of compressed-function equality and rewriting hr give equality at j. Function extensionality recovers all coordinates, without sorting or quotienting.
mathematical_review.finite_cardinality: card_le_card_of_injOn applies to the actual finite deletion image with the explicit compression map, the written MapsTo proof, and normalization-based InjOn proof. Surjectivity is unnecessary for the desired upper bound.
mathematical_review.native_payment: The copied generic cardinality theorem converts card(orderedFactorTuples k d) to native fouvryTau k d at d>0. The specialization cases K: zero is contradictory under hK, while K=succ k uses Nat.succ_eq_add_one and Nat.add_sub_cancel to identify k=K-1.
mathematical_review.final_chain: The final theorem converts tau_K(n) to the exact existing tuple carrier card at n>0, invokes the imported finite indexed-cover truncation with the original hK,hn,hcut, bounds each divisor fiber by tau_(K-1)(d), and collapses the constant Fin K outer sum to K copies of the same truncated divisor sum. truncatedDivisors unfolds to precisely n.divisors.filter(d<=D).
zero_and_empty_cases: Final target preserves K>=2, n>=1 and n^(K-1)<=D^K exactly; no endpoint relaxation or additional supplier hypothesis is present.

New compression lemmas are valid already for k=0, where Fin 1 has only the pivot, the compressed tuple has empty product 1, and an actual deletion fiber of positive d is empty unless d=1. The injection proof remains total by the off-pivot existence theorem.
K=0 is explicitly eliminated in the fiber specialization. K=1 is excluded by its hK hypothesis although the generic compression statement already handles that finite boundary.

d=0 is allowed in normalization and the product/divisibility identities, but excluded before entering the divisor-coordinate carrier and native tau cardinality theorem. The final d lies in n.divisors, so Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors gives exactly the required d>0.
n=0 is excluded in the final theorem. D=0 with positive n and K>=2 cannot satisfy the cutoff; empty finite sets otherwise pose no counting issue.
mathematical_review.cancellation_and_multiplicity: The new compression uses pivot normalization rather than division or cancellation. The imported finite core retains its 0<n assumption when proving eraseAt injective on the original fixed-product fibers. This existing injection preserves the cardinalities before the second, compression injection is applied; repeated numerical factors in different ordered positions are retained.
